correctness.rationale: Bridge excursion GF B(z,u)=1/[1-u(1-sqrt(1-4z))]; conditionally independent excursion signs imply E[D^2|lengths]=sum ell_i^2. Marking by (z d/dz)^2 and differentiating in u yields Cov(K,D^2)=-n(n-1)4^n/(12 binom(2n,n)). The Chung-Feller uniform occupation law gives Var(D^2)=4n(n+2)(n(n+2)-3)/45 and the marked GF gives Var(K)=4n+2-b_n-b_n^2, hence the negative correlation limit. Independently enumerated every balanced bridge for n=1,..,8 and recovered covariances 0,-4/9,-8/5,-128/35,-1280/189,-2560/231,-7168/429,-458752/19305.
